explication: Caddy is an extensible HTTPS server platform. An operator starts the CLI or submits configuration through the admin API; configuration is loaded, optionally adapted from Caddyfile syntax, and applied to the runtime. The runtime provisions TLS and HTTP applications, accepts client connections, matches routes, and serves files or proxies upstream requests. Automatic certificate issuance and storage support HTTPS, while logging, metrics, and events provide operational visibility. The graph emphasizes documented capabilities and sampled call paths; some application orchestration is represented at subsystem level.
